faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Paynote.

items.q: Do I need internet to use Paynote?
items.a: You can record transactions offline. Data automatically syncs once you reconnect.
Paynote sends automated SMS and voice reminders to customers based on their payment schedule, so you never have to chase debts manually.

items.q: Can I manage more than one store?
items.a: Yes. With paid plans you can manage multiple stores and seller accounts from a single dashboard.
Paynote supports UZS and USD, so you can keep balances in the currency that suits your business.
Your data is stored securely in the cloud and backed up automatically. Only you and the sellers you invite can access it.
Download the app, register for a free account, and start adding your customers and debts in minutes.
